title: Get started
goal: A first flight: arm it, stop it, bring it home and land.

steps.text: Press and hold Arm in the Control tab.
steps.hint: Armed, its motors answer commands. Disarmed, it drifts.

steps.text: Choose HOLD in the Mode menu in the Control tab.
Press Return to launch in the Control tab.
steps.hint: Return to launch brings it back to where it started.

steps.text: Press Land in the Control tab.
steps.hint: Land brings it down where it is.
